_doc: Min-max hull-locked module auto-fitting policy (game/fleet/fit_net.py). Every T1-T5 hull in every division resolves deterministically via detect_by_hull / sentinel_detect_by_hull / flagship_detect_by_hull to its exact matching module loadout, stripping off-role and wrong-resource modules automatically.

Mining._zero_note: 2026-11-24 23:49 UTC (Zero): mix [["ore", 65], ["ice", 20], ["gas", 15]] -> ore 100. Laser-only miners are no longer refitted to ice or gas: every ice and gas good the bids take is held already (water ice 47,139 against a best bid 56 cr 834 deep; nitrogen ice 63,842 at 2 cr; argon, neon, nebula, ion, krypton, xenon bid 2 cr; hydrogen, plasma, chlorine bids >= 10 cr take 2,545 units against 6,549 held), while iron, the short chain, needs lasers; 147 miner fit-network runs in 6 h cost -352,388 cr steady and -248,391 cr once. Ships already fitted with a harvester keep their specialty (detect_by_module).
Mining._suggi_policy: 2026-11-25 (Suggi directive): full automatic T1-T5 utility + defense module fitting restored across ore, ice, and gas miners; upgrades are CapEx and never penalize division operating score.

Military._tune_apophis: 2026-11-25 (Suggi directive): full automatic T1-T5 weapon, defense, and utility loadouts restored across all Military drones and sentinels; fuel-guzzling afterburners remain off-role per empirical fuelplan data (3 fuel/jump vs 7-11).

Trade._note: 4C Bursar Desks and 5A Station Refiners/Bursars are zero-module docked Bursar desks; 4A Express Arbitrage, 4B Bulk Trade Haulers, and 5B Mobile Field Workshops fit T1-T5 shields, cargo expanders, and fuel_optimizer.

_blueprint_note: 2026-11-27 (Trinity, Suggi approved): Full T1-T5 Masterplan blueprint module escalation active across Mining, Military, Logistics, Trade, Intel, and Command. Zero afterburners in any loadout (fuel_optimizer everywhere); singleton utility/defense deduplication enforced in fit_net.py.
